content.short: Nuvola is a cross-chain DePIN aggregator delivering multiple revenue streams to NVL token holders.
content.description: Nuvola is a DePIN aggregator, a first for Cardano. DePIN is short for Decentralized Physical Infrastructure Network, which brings cutting-edge Web 3.0 solutions to a broad number of real-world applications. Being decentralized at heart, DePIN companies pay their network supporters, such as node operators, rewards as incentive for maintaining the network. This is where Nuvola comes in. Nuvola enters into chain-agnostic, strategic partnerships with these promising companies in exchange for lucrative network operator revenues.
